name: MAST
source: Coil elements: Fusion Equilibrium Challenge input files (mast_public_test), see scripts/build_machine_files.py. R0, TF turns and wall box: public machine facts and coil positions.
wall_box_note: Plasma current may flow only inside this box: centre column at R = 0.20 m, outer limit just inside the P5 coils, height +-1.6 m (below P2).
coil_margin_note: Grid cells within this distance (m) of a coil element are taken out of the plasma region.
column_scale_note: Solenoid factor (user setting; load_machine('mast', solenoid_scale=1.0) uses the column as stored). Default 0.5, set from documentation only: the organisers' data notes say magnetics_sol_current reads exactly 2x the level-2 pf_active solenoid current and leave the convention open; Berkery et al. 2021 (UKAEA-CCFE-PR(21)79) give a MAST solenoid (P1) current of about +22 kA before the swing, half the +44 to +46 kA this column reads before breakdown in the challenge inputs. The geometry has 656 single-turn solenoid elements.
